tex_content.source:
\label{sec:wave-energy-uniqueness}

Let $U\subset\R^n$ be bounded with smooth boundary. Consider
$$(45)\qquad
\begin{cases}
u_{tt}-\Delta u=f&\text{in }U_T,\\
u=g&\text{on }\Gamma_T,\\
u_t=h&\text{on }U\times\{t=0\}.
\end{cases}$$
